verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's docs say it can query data directly from S3, GCS and Azure Blob Storage, with S3 credentials stored as SECRET objects. It also supports DuckLake, an open lakehouse format, on your own object storage, so querying in place is supported in principle. However, the pack never names Iceberg, Delta or Parquet specifically, so the open-table-format half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit Iceberg support, explicit Delta Lake support, documented Parquet querying, independent or hands-on corroboration of in-place object-storage queries.
